mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bill (user_id, category_id, ledger_id, amount, type, remark, bill_date, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{categoryId}, #{ledgerId}, #{amount}, #{type}, #{remark}, #{billDate}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE bill SET category_id = #{categoryId}, ledger_id = #{ledgerId}, amount = #{amount}, type = #{type}, remark = #{remark}, bill_date = #{billDate}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bill WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT * FROM bill ORDER BY id
